sloka: हावयामास विधिना राममङ्गलकारणात् ।घृतम् श्वेतानि माल्यानि समिधः श्वेतसर्षपान् ॥२-२५-२८॥
transliteration: hāvayāmāsa vidhinā rāmamaṅgalakāraṇāt ।ghṛtam śvetāni mālyāni samidhaḥ śvetasarṣapān ॥2-25-28॥

translations.english: Noble Kausalya procured clarified butter, garlands of white flowers, sacred fuel, and grains of white mustard seed (for oblations to the gods).
